message:
fix(messaging): release reply listeners after failed delivery

A rejected browser send left comctx's request listener registered. Retries
to a missing content script or invalidated context accumulated listeners.
Patch the pinned injector at the request owner so it releases only the
failed request, preserves the original error, and leaves concurrent calls
subscribed. Keep source and published runtime changes in pnpm's frozen
patch contract and document the source-archive requirement.

Exercise the installed dependency through both production adapters. The
unpatched package fails four delivery/concurrency cases; all eight cases
pass with the patch. The strict test/import-closure type check also passes.
Caller timeouts and remote cancellation remain separate review work; the
full repository gates remain blocked by recorded process kills.

message:
fix(registry): reject inherited category names

The category validator accepted Object prototype properties because it
used the in operator against a plain category table. Require an own table
entry before compilation so constructor, toString, valueOf and __proto__
cannot become category identifiers.

All nine schema cases pass after the repair; the four inherited-name
cases fail against the recovered implementation. The strict changed-test
and import-closure type check passes. The complete catalog compiler still
hits the separately recorded host process kill.

message:
fix(verify): bound Chrome debugger requests and require artifact smoke

Chrome debugger commands could remain pending after their socket closed.
Give the connection an explicit owner that bounds startup and responses,
rejects pending work on transport failure, and releases request timers and
event subscriptions during disposal. Keep protocol result unwrapping in
one place and give the verification workspace its own tests and type check.

Run the existing Chrome artifact validator unconditionally in CI and
require exactly one downloaded archive. Update the workflow guide to
match the current jobs, local build inputs and public runner behavior.

Nine debugger lifetime cases pass. A direct probe keeps the recovered
client pending on socket close and rejects with the repaired client. The
verification package type/syntax check and native workflow lint pass.
No current browser startup or bundle pass is claimed: the local browser
download returned HTTP 403 and the native Chrome build was killed.
